description: This file defines types and functions for handling chat target prefixes, including parsing, resolving, and permission checking related to chat IDs, GUIDs, and identifiers, as well as service prefix handling.

methods.name: isAllowedParsedChatSender
methods.description: Checks if a sender is allowed based on the allow list, chat ID, GUID, identifier, or handle.

methods.name: stripPrefix
methods.description: Removes a specified prefix from a string and trims the result.

methods.name: startsWithAnyPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with any of the provided prefixes.

methods.name: resolveServicePrefixedTarget
methods.description: Resolves a target with a service prefix, determining if it's a chat target or handle.

methods.name: resolveServicePrefixedChatTarget
methods.description: Resolves a chat target with service and chat-specific prefixes.

methods.name: parseChatTargetPrefixesOrThrow
methods.description: Parses chat target prefixes and returns the corresponding target or throws on invalid input.

methods.name: resolveServicePrefixedAllowTarget
methods.description: Resolves an allow target with a service prefix.

methods.name: resolveServicePrefixedOrChatAllowTarget
methods.description: Resolves either a service-prefixed allow target or a chat allow target.

methods.name: createAllowedChatSenderMatcher
methods.description: Creates a function to check if a chat sender is allowed based on normalization and parsing functions.

methods.name: parseChatAllowTargetPrefixes
methods.description: Parses chat allow target prefixes into specific target types.
